name: AI-Assisted UI/UX Design
pill: / AI-ASSISTED UI UX DESIGN · FASTER ITERATION
headline: AI-assisted UI UX design: more ideas, tested sooner, decided by a designer.
hero_lead: I use AI tools such as Claude, Figma AI, v0 and Gemini to research, explore and prototype faster, so you get more iterations in less time. Every UX decision is still mine.
seo_title: AI-Assisted UI UX Design | Muhammad Babar, AI Product Designer
description: AI-assisted UI UX design: faster research, more design options and working prototypes with Claude, Figma AI and v0, with every UX decision made by a designer.
summary: AI speeds up the slow, repetitive parts of design. Judgment, taste and responsibility for the result stay with me.
overview:
Most of a design project is not drawing screens. It is reading research, comparing options, writing microcopy, documenting components and rebuilding prototypes after feedback. That is where AI helps. I use it to summarise interviews, generate layout options to react to, draft UX copy and turn ideas into working HTML prototypes in hours instead of days.

You still work with a designer who owns every decision. I review, edit and test everything the tools produce, and you get a clean Figma file and design system your team can build from. I have delivered products designed with Claude for clients, and I write about where these tools help and where they don’t, for example in [Claude Design vs Figma AI](/insights/claude-design-vs-figma-ai/).

faqs.question: Will my product look AI-generated?
faqs.answer: No. AI gives me options to react to. The final design follows your users, brand and design system, and every screen is refined by hand.

faqs.question: Which AI tools do you use?
faqs.answer: Mainly Claude and Claude Design, Figma AI, v0 and Gemini, with Figma for the final design. I choose the tools per project.

faqs.question: Does AI make the project faster?
faqs.answer: You get more iterations and working prototypes sooner. Timelines still depend on scope, so I give you a plan and quote after our first call.

faqs.question: Is my product data safe with AI tools?
faqs.answer: I only share what a task needs, follow your confidentiality rules, and can work without AI tools on anything sensitive.

faqs.question: How do we start?
faqs.answer: Send me a short brief through the contact page. We will have a call about your product, users and timeline, and I will come back with a plan and quote.
